title: Warm up with a cylinder, then compare a cup
alt_text: A light cylinder guide with an axis and ellipses is compared with a real handled cup, with prompts to observe taper, handle angle, and rim opening.
caption: Begin with a simple volume, then compare its guides with the actual cup.
